Mehakdeep Kaur

Senior Client Manager

Mehakdeep Kaur is a Senior Client Manager at SH Elevate Tax Inc., passionate about helping individuals, families, and business owners feel confident and supported with their taxes and financial matters. She takes the time to understand each client's situation and works to make the tax process simple and stress-free. Whether assisting with tax planning, compliance, or financial guidance, she is committed to delivering solutions that make a difference.
